scope_outcomes.criterion: A secondary reader must substantively interpret the thinker on at least one supplied engagement theme or introduce a clearly supported additional theme, with a verbatim anchor.
scope_outcomes.basis: The full held article substantively interprets Weber’s class, status, honor, closure, market relations, subjective interests, class formation and relation to Marx, and introduces exploitation as a central additional theme.
limitations: This is one reader’s article, not the complete reception of Max Weber or the complete work of Erik Olin Wright.
The article does not address every engagement theme, including political capitalism, imperialism and tax-farming.
The supplied plan is guide-derived and reconstructed rather than the missing original plan.
